test.create_query: CREATE TABLE ism_stage ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (m, s) AS SELECT toYYYYMM(l_shipdate) AS m, l_orderkey % 10 AS s, l_orderkey, l_partkey, l_quantity, l_extendedprice, l_shipdate, l_shipmode FROM tpch10.lineitem

CREATE TABLE ism (l_orderkey Int32, l_partkey Int32, l_quantity Float64, l_extendedprice Float64, l_shipdate Date, l_shipmode String) ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3, filename = 'iceberg_scale_manifests_' || toString(toUnixTimestamp64Micro(now64(6))) || '/') PARTITION BY toMonthNumSinceEpoch(l_shipdate)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO ism SELECT * EXCEPT (m, s) FROM ism_stage WHERE m = {year} * 100 + {month} AND s = {slice} ORDER BY l_orderkey SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 6000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 6000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0, iceberg_insert_max_rows_in_data_file = 1
CREATE TABLE ism_cold ENGINE = IcebergS3(perf_s3, filename = (SELECT extract(_path, 'iceberg_scale_manifests_[0-9]+/') FROM ism LIMIT 1)) SETTINGS use_iceberg_metadata_files_cache = 0

SELECT throwIf(count() != (SELECT uniqExact(m, s) FROM ism_stage) OR sum(toUInt64(summary['changed-partition-count'])) != count() OR max(toUInt64(summary['total-records'])) != 59986052 OR max(toUInt64(summary['total-data-files'])) != (SELECT sum(intDiv(c + 5999, 6000)) FROM (SELECT count() AS c FROM ism_stage GROUP BY m, s))) FROM system.iceberg_history WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'ism'

SELECT throwIf(count() != (SELECT max(toUInt64(summary['total-data-files'])) FROM system.iceberg_history WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'ism') OR uniqExact(partition) != 84) FROM system.iceberg_files WHERE database = 'default' AND table = 'ism' AND content = 0
SELECT throwIf(count() != 0) FROM ism_cold WHERE l_orderkey < 0 SETTINGS iceberg_manifest_decode_concurrency = {decode}

SELECT throwIf((SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_orderkey < 0) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_orderkey < -1) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_orderkey > 100000000) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_orderkey > 200000000) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_partkey < 0) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_partkey < -1) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_partkey > 100000000) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_partkey > 200000000) != 0)

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(l_quantity)) != (SELECT count(), sum(toFloat64(l_quantity)) FROM tpch10.lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01')) FROM ism_cold WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01' SETTINGS use_iceberg_manifest_list_partition_pruning = {prune}

SELECT throwIf((count(), sum(l_quantity)) != (SELECT count(), sum(toFloat64(l_quantity)) FROM tpch10.lineitem)) FROM ism SETTINGS use_parquet_metadata_cache = 0, log_comment = 'iceberg_scale_manifests.full_scan'

SELECT throwIf(count() = 0 OR argMax(ProfileEvents['ParquetMetadataCacheHits'], event_time_microseconds) != 0 OR argMax(ProfileEvents['S3GetObject'], event_time_microseconds) < 10252) FROM system.query_log WHERE type = 'QueryFinish' AND log_comment = 'iceberg_scale_manifests.full_scan'
test.query: SELECT count() FROM ism_cold WHERE l_orderkey < 0 SETTINGS iceberg_manifest_decode_concurrency = {decode}

SELECT (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_orderkey < 0) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_orderkey < -1) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_orderkey > 100000000) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_orderkey > 200000000) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_partkey < 0) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_partkey < -1) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_partkey > 100000000) + (SELECT count() FROM ism WHERE l_partkey > 200000000)
SELECT count(), sum(l_quantity) FROM ism_cold WHERE l_shipdate >= '1995-01-01' AND l_shipdate < '1996-01-01' SETTINGS use_iceberg_manifest_list_partition_pruning = {prune}
SELECT count(), sum(l_quantity) FROM ism SETTINGS use_parquet_metadata_cache = 0
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS ism_cold, ism, ism_stage SYNC
